title: Rabbi Yehuda ben Pappus
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a prominent figure in the time of Rabban Gamliel. In [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:9](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.2.9.3), Rabban Gamliel and Rabbi Yehoshua stepped to the side of the road. They saw Rabbi Yehuda ben Pappus approaching while sinking into the road. Rabban Gamliel asked Rabbi Yehoshua, “Who is this man drawing attention to himself?” He replied, “It is Yehuda ben Pappus, who does everything for the sake of Heaven.” [Bava Kamma 81b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.81b.10-11) tells a similar story about Rabbi and Yehuda ben Nekusa. Hyman suggests that he may have been the father of Pappus ben Yehuda, Rabbi Akiva’s colleague in [Berakhot 61b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.61b.6-8).[^1]

notes.text: The Jerusalem Talmud explains why the travelers were allowed to go around obstacles. The Bavli gives Rabbi Chiyya and the alternate spelling Kenusa beside Nekusa. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1636&lang=en) cites the Pappus road story. It is unclear which of the two men Hyman means in his conjecture about Pappus’s father.
